title: Scan-copy return configuration
statement: Given a symbol alphabet, a natural number $k$ of work tapes, a finite input word $x$, a tape index $i\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, a configuration $d$ on input $x$, and $r\in\mathbb{N}$, define the scan-copy return configuration by first applying the scan-and-write configuration operation to $d$ at input position $\min(r,|x|)$, in the rewind phase, with parameter $|x|$. Its work-tape head positions are then set to those of $d$, except that the head on tape $i$ is shifted by $r-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A tape index $i$ among the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The definition of the scan-and-write configuration operation is not supplied, so its effect cannot be described more specifically.
